species.name: hare
species.lore: Ears up before you have finished arriving.

species.name: vole
species.lore: Lives in a tunnel it can reach from anywhere in the field.

species.name: moth
species.lore: Goes to the brightest thing in the room. Always has.

species.name: mantis
species.lore: Holds perfectly still until the first exchange is already over.

species.name: adder
species.lore: Strikes once and lets the strike keep working.

species.name: fox
species.lore: Watches how you work, then declines to be where you are.

species.name: owl
species.lore: Arrives without the sound that should have preceded it.

species.name: boar
species.lore: One direction, committed to entirely.

species.name: beetle
species.lore: Wearing most of a suit of armour and in no hurry.

species.name: crow
species.lore: Has heard what you sound like and can do it back.

species.name: shrew
species.lore: Must eat constantly or die, and fights like it.

species.name: newt
species.lore: Grows the limb back. Grows most things back.

species.name: carp
species.lore: Old, cold, and extremely difficult to hurry.

species.name: heron
species.lore: Stands in the shallows for an hour and then is very fast once.

species.name: otter
species.lore: Treats the whole encounter as a game it is winning.

species.name: eel
species.lore: Holds a charge it did not ask anybody about.

species.name: toad
species.lore: Coated in something that makes every grip fail.

species.name: bat
species.lore: Does not need the light to know exactly where you are.

species.name: rat
species.lore: Has outlived several better ideas about what should live here.

species.name: olm
species.lore: A blind cave salamander, pale as a root and older than the cave.

species.name: crystal jelly
species.lore: It was glowing on its own long before any of this. Green, at the rim.

species.name: disc coral
species.lore: A colony that has been red since before the word existed.

species.name: sea anemone
species.lore: Waves in a current nobody else can feel, and burns cherry-dark.

bolt.name: Bolt
bolt.text: Withdrawing always works, and it is faster when hurt.

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.text: Sometimes simply is not there when the shot lands.

phototaxis.name: Phototaxis
phototaxis.text: Hits a bright label much harder.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.text: The first strike of a fight lands double.

venom.name: Venom
venom.text: The target keeps bleaching after the hit.

cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.text: Half again as likely to get a label off cleanly.

silent.name: Silent
silent.text: Cannot be struck first, and hits a little harder.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Much more damage, at twice the bleaching.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.text: Copies your band, so you are never strong against it.

spearfall.name: Spearfall
spearfall.text: Always moves first on turn one.

play.name: Play
play.text: Recovers when swapped in, and is easy to befriend.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.text: Sometimes shocks the target into a lost turn.

mucus.name: Mucus
mucus.text: Bright labels do much less damage to it.

echo.name: Echo
echo.text: Finds a target the fitted filter has blinded you to.

wellspring.name: Wellspring
wellspring.text: Cannot be bleached out in one blow.

shiftwalk.name: Shiftwalk
shiftwalk.text: A wide Stokes shift -- hard to jam, and it dodges.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.text: High yield: more damage, and it burns down fast.

slowburn.name: Slow Burn
slowburn.text: Low yield: dim, but it lasts.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.text: A protein shell takes the edge off a hit.

nightsight.name: Nightsight
nightsight.text: Far-red: moves first against anything bluer.

hardlight.name: Hard Light
hardlight.text: Blue and violent: more damage, more bleaching.

unmeasured.name: Unmeasured
unmeasured.text: Stats are class defaults -- his damage is unpredictable.

photostable.name: Antifade Cocktail
photostable.text: Trolox and an oxygen scavenger: bleaches much slower.

unblinking.name: Triplet Quencher
unblinking.text: A reducing-and-oxidizing system: bleaches slower still.

shielded.name: Passivation Coat
shielded.text: A blocking protein coat: bleaches a little slower.

turn_on.name: Photoactivation Label
turn_on.text: Dark until struck -- the hit that lands lights it, and its own next hit lands much harder.
